propositions: test_rendered_output_is_byte_identical_to_the_landed_renderer intermittently kills its pytest-xdist worker on macOS py3.13 due to exceeding the 300s per-test timeout guard
the test processes 884 renderable units with ~1768 serial pandoc spawns in a single monolithic loop, requiring 91.6s idle and 504.8s under CPU contention (1.7x the 300s budget)
pytest-timeout's thread method calls os._exit(1) to kill the worker outright without traceback when the timeout fires, appearing as worker crash rather than test failure
chunking the test into fixed-size batches with _EQUIVALENCE_CHUNK=40 makes per-test cost bounded and independent of corpus size, limiting each case to ~4.2s idle
all 884 units must still be compared against the oracle with real pandoc and _EQUIVALENCE_STRIDE=1 to preserve the byte-identity property the test protects
a coverage guard test must verify that all chunks reassemble to exactly _renderable_units and that the total is >= 100 to prevent silent unit drops
